— 200 Returned if the request to move the scan configuration to another folder was successful.
202
The request to move the scan configuration to the Trash has successfully been accepted, and will be
processed.
RESPONSE HEADERS
string <uri>
Example: "/configs/:config_id/status/:tracking_id"
Use the contents of this header appended to the prefix /was/v2  to
execute lookups on the current status of the resource
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
Schema not provided
400 Returned if your request body is invalid or if you specify a folder name with invalid characters.
404 Returned if Tenable Web App Scanning cannot find the specified scan configuration.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
